epoch_record.flow_fingerprint: hash covering real CARLA flow plus decision-core state
epoch_record.current_reality: only observation fields already authorized by protocol v2.2

relation_elements.relation_element_id: element identifier inside the completed experience

epoch_record.possibility_distribution: current possibility distribution before real realization

relation_element_probes.relation_ablated_distribution: same current decision with only this relation element withheld internally
relation_element_probes.distribution_effect: epoch-local distribution change; not memory importance
relation_element_probes.role_trace: dynamic structural role descriptors in the current judgment
relation_element_probes.generated_possibilities: possibilities whose construction used this relation element

relation_group_probes.source_relation_element_ids: two or more relations used together
relation_group_probes.before_hash: real-flow fingerprint before internal group probe
relation_group_probes.after_hash: real-flow fingerprint after internal group probe
relation_group_probes.group_ablated_distribution: same current decision with the relation set withheld internally
relation_group_probes.joint_distribution_effect: joint epoch-local effect used to expose redundancy/synergy
relation_group_probes.generated_possibilities: possibilities constructed with the relation set

post_realization.realization_ref: reference to the one real applied action for the epoch
post_realization.outcome_description: change, persistence, no-change, failure, or other observed result
post_realization.closure_method: evidence method for relation-process closure, not a fixed duration threshold
post_realization.provenance: relation-element genealogy copied from decision-time participation and reconstruction

interpretation: Participation Spectrum is vector-valued: structural role/construction trace plus counterfactual distribution effect.
Zero individual distribution effect does not imply non-participation when structural traces exist.
Joint probes are required for relation sets used together when redundancy or synergy can hide individual effects.
forbidden: binary selected/rejected memory gate as primary evaluation
future state or outcome leakage into decision-time calculation
counterfactual probe that changes or advances the real flow
collapse of reconstruction axes into one memory score
interpreting zero individual distribution effect as proof of non-participation
